name: collection
//: @playwright/test is held to its minor: the browsers come from nixpkgs (flake.nix takes playwright-driver.browsers, whose version flake.lock fixes), each minor expects the browser builds of its own release, and a minor nix does not have fails every e2e run at launch. Move it when nixpkgs moves.
//biome: @biomejs/biome is held to an exact version, the one nixpkgs gives the pre-commit hook. Two installers reach for this linter — nix before a commit, pnpm in CI — and a linter that disagrees with itself between them would reformat on every commit and fail the gate it just passed. Move it when nixpkgs moves.
